name: moji-pv-vendor
description: Builds vendor/ai-sdk.min.js (the second AI service's official SDK bundled for the browser). Run: cd tools/vendor && npm ci && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/*! @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.128.0 | MIT License | (c) 2023 Anthropic, PBC | see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md */" --outfile=../../vendor/ai-sdk.min.js
